name: Viewport
description: Work with screen properties and effects.

static_functions.name: ProjectWorldToScreen
static_functions.description: Transforms a 3D world-space vector into 2D screen coordinates

static_functions.description: Transforms a 2D screen coordinates into 3D world-space location

return.description: Table with the world Position and the Direction the screen point looks at

static_functions.name: SetHardwareCursor
static_functions.description: Loads and sets a hardware cursor in the game from a PNG image
static_functions.description_long:
Loads and sets a hardware cursor in the game from a PNG image
Note: due an engine limitation modifying an already set cursor image will not change the cursor until the game is restarted

parameters.name: cursor_path
parameters.description: a PNG image relative to Assets/

parameters.name: hotspot
parameters.description: Click point of the cursor image, in pixels

parameters.name: is_enabled

static_functions.description: Manually sets the Blood Screen intensity
static_functions.description_long: If you don't want the Blood Screen to be overridden by the default damage effect, disable it first with Viewport.SetBloodScreenEnabled(false)
